text: Could you make a logo for my plant shop? I've been thinking about this little shop a lot, so getting a logo made feels like an exciting step. The shop is called Little Sprout, and I want the logo to be square. For the design, just put a simple green sprout above the name on a white background, nothing fancy. I'm probably over-explaining because the whole thing means a lot to me.
